4. Earlier, on 19.09.2024, 01.10.2024 and 27.11.2024 following orders were passed:
Order
"1. Heard
Sri Shobhit Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicants, Ms. Vishpa,

learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and the learned A.G.A. Perused the record.
2. Applicants have approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with the following prayer:-
"It is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow the application and quash the cognizance order dated 19.02.2024 passed by Additional I Civil Judge (Junior Division), Rampur, as well as Charge sheet dated 13.12.2023 in Case No. 99 of 2024 (under Sections 498-A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act), arising out Case Crime No. 61 of 2023, (under Sections 498-A, 323,
377, 504 and 506 of IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act), Police Station Mahila Thana, District Rampur, (State of U.P. Vs. Sumit Sharma and Others) and which pending in the Court of Additional I Civil Judge (Junior Division), Rampur.

sentences.text: It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the entire criminal proceeding in Case No. 99 of 2024, which pending in the Court of Additional I Civil Judge (Junior Division), Rampur during the pendency of the present miscellaneous application before this Hon'ble Court, Otherwise the applicant will suffer irreparable loss and injury.

entities.text: Court of Additional I Civil Judge (Junior Division), Rampur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: And/Or to pass any other/further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper on the facts and circumstances of the case in the interest of justice."
3. Learned counsel for the appellants and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 have jointly submitted that the parties have settled their dispute out of Court on the basis of compromise.
They have drawn the attention of this Court towards compromise deed dated 25.6.2024 in which it is stated that by amicable settlement both the parties want to resolve the aforesaid dispute.
It is next submitted that the entire proceedings be dropped in light of the compromise deed filed by the parties.
It is further submitted that the parties are also ready to appear before the court concerned for verification of compromise.
4. Learned AGA is having no objection, if any, such direction is given to the court concerned for verification of compromise executed between the parties.

5. As both the parties have amicably settled their dispute and compromise has also been arrived between them, therefore, it is directed that both the parties shall appear before the court concerned Sumit Kumar Sharma And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33915483/
2 within ten days and shall file an application along with the certified copy of this order for verification of compromise, enter between them.

sentences.text: 6. If any such compromise is moved, then the court below shall verify the compromise, in accordance with law, and shall pass a reasoned order accepting or rejecting of compromise, in accordance with law and transmit verification report to this Court.

7. Put up this matter on 01.10.2024 as fresh.
8.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive measures shall be adopted against the appellants in the aforesaid case.

9. Office is directed to submit a report on the next date fixed in respect of verification report, if any,
forwarded by the court concerned."
Order Dated : 01.10.2024

"Sri Shobhit Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicants, Ms. Vishpa,
learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and Smt. Ladli Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State are present.

Learned counsel for both the parties jointly submitted that parties settled their dispute arising out of offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 377, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act,
on the basis of compromise dated 25.06.2024 which is annexed at page no. 48 to 50 of the paper book.
It is further submitted that both the parties are residing as husband and wife after the settlement.
Both the parties are directed to appear before the court concerned within three weeks from today for verification.
Applicant is directed to file supplementary affidavit annexing certified copy of the compromise as well as proceedings of compromise.
Put up this case as fresh on 12.11.2024.

Till the next date of listing proceedings of Case No. 99 of 2024 (State of U.P. Vs. Sumit Sharma and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 61 of 2023, under Sections 498-A, 323, 377, 504, 506 of I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District Rampur, pending in the Court of Additional Civil Judge (J.D.), Ist, Rampur shall remain stayed against the applicants."

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that due to strike at the concerned District Court, the parties could not appear before the court concerned for verification of compromise within the stipulated period as directed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 01.10.2024.
Therefore, some time may be granted to the parties to appear before the court concerned for verification of compromise.
In view of the above, both the parties are directed to appear before the court below along with copy of compromise deed as well as a certified copy of this order.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise and after ensuring the presence of parties, pass an appropriate order with respect to the same in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one month from today.

While passing the order verifying the compromise, the concerned court shall also record the statement of the parties as to whether all the terms and conditions mentioned in the original compromise deed, so filed, have been fulfilled or not?
Upon due verification of compromise, the court below may pass appropriate order in that regard and send a report to this Court.
Put up this case on 20.01.2025, as fresh.

Interim order, if any, is extended till the next date of listing."
5.
In compliance of the aforesaid orders, compromise has been verified by order dated 20.12.2024 passed by Additional Civil Judge (J.D.)/ Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 1, Rampur.

6.

7. Learned A.G.A. for the State accepts that the parties have entered into a compromise and the copy of the same has also been enclosed alongwith verification order, they have no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.
